premises: Interstitial impurities (O, N) cause phase segregation and softening in refractory HEAs at high temperature
A thin alumina coating can act as an oxidation barrier on high-temperature alloys
ALD can deposit a uniform ~100 nm alumina coating on complex alloy surfaces
Preserving the single-phase microstructure prevents impurity-induced softening and maintains strength/ductility
